summary: 22-year-old man (name not released; a seasonal summer employee in the valley) scrambling with three friends on a high buttress near Harmel's Guest Ranch in Taylor Canyon lost his footing and fell an estimated 60 feet, suffering life-ending injuries; dead when EMS arrived
location: high buttress near Harmel's Guest Ranch, Taylor Canyon
responding_agency: Western Mountain Rescue Team (incident command); Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Gunnison Valley Health EMS
notes: Technical lowering systems used in the recovery; 12-person GVH EMS mutual aid response.
